storage_traffic.queue_depth_scope: max across physical owners: outstanding page commands per host channel sampled at admission, including the admitted command

hbf0.memory: outstanding page commands per host channel sampled at admission, including the admitted command

storage_traffic.page_utilization_scope: logical payload / sum of per-access page-rounded spans; repeated accesses count again; not unique resident capacity utilization

nand_read_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host requests are separate

nand_program_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host writes are separate

storage_traffic.accounting_semantics: host_transfer_bytes is logical host payload; physical_* and pages_read/pages_programmed are NAND media accounting; null means not fully recorded; operation_counts classifies task-owner ledgers, not media operations; service_ns is analytical

dram_traffic.service_time_scope: service_ns sums per-task/owner completion spans, which may overlap; it is neither elapsed wall time nor data-bus busy time. resource_totals contains actual per-resource occupied time and bytes.
dram_traffic.accounting_semantics: resolved analytical burst bytes and controller waits; null means not fully recorded; empty organization_profiles is not evidence of complete geometry reporting; no device accuracy claim

purpose: runtime optimization benchmark; not a formal scan point

benchmark_timing.prefill_wall_scope: sum of Prefill cohort intervals; excludes initial setup/control plane

native_page_loop_diagnostic.purpose: direct elapsed-time decomposition; not a speedup or mathematical extrapolation
native_page_loop_diagnostic.timer_scope: _compiled_nand._run call including Numba dispatch and perf_counter overhead
